title: Review of Diagnostic Yield of MRI Brain Results in Children Under Age 3 Years
brief_summary: The investigators aim to identify the frequency with which an elective brain MRI yields and etiologic diagnosis to explain its indication. The protocol includes children undergoing elective brain MRI with anesthesia prior to their third birthday.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female aged 0-36 months who received anesthesia (volatile gas anesthesia) or IV sedation (propofol, dexmedetomidine, barbiturates, benzodiazepines, or other agents) for brain MRI

Exclusion Criteria:

* MRI without sedation, brain MRI plus additional MRI imaging, i.e. spine, heart, etc., sedated MRI by a member of other department besides Anesthesiology.
study_population: Children under age 3 undergoing MRI brain with anesthesia or sedation between Dec 13, 2015 and Dec 13, 2016
